about: The line Wang Bi (周易注) names master (主) of each hexagram, read by hand. `line` is the master line; `where` is the note the phrase stands in; masters: [] means he names none. Sources: chinese-classics-reference zhouyi-zhushu and 8bitoracle-next wangBiZhu.ts; candidates from series/wangbi.json.

1.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 01-qian.json; 主 only in the Wenyan note on King Wen — no master named

2.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 02-kun.json; 二主必危 and L3's 不為事主 — not a hexagram master

3.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 03-zhun.json; 得主則定 and L1's 民思其主 are a ruler the people seek — no line named

4.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 04-meng.json; Judgment note 二為眾陰之主: L2 master of the yin lines, not named master of Meng

5.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 05-xu.json; L6 以一陰而為三陽之主 is host to the three yang lines, not master of Xu

6.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 06-song.json; the Tuan note asks 必有善聽之主焉，其在二乎 and Kong reads L2; kept L5, which he names outright

17.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 17-sui.json; L1's 意无所主 is 'no fixed intent'

masters.en: Line five, master of Biting Through

21.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 21-shihe.json; L4's 為陰之主 is not master of Shihe

30.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 30-li.json; Judgment note 以柔順為主 names a quality, softness, not a line

35.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 35-jin.json; L5's 陰為明主 is 'a bright ruler', not named master of Jin

masters.zh: 明夷之主，在於上六，上六為至闇者也
masters.en: Line six, master of Darkening of the Light: the darkest line

36.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 36-mingyi.json; L3's 去闇主 is the dark ruler removed

38.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 38-kui.json; L2's 遇主於巷 meets its lord, L5 — not a hexagram master

39.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 39-jian.json; L3 為下卦之主 is master of the lower trigram only

41.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 41-sun.json; L3's 內无其主 — not a hexagram master

42.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 42-yi2.json; L2's 生物之主 is the Supreme Deity; L3's 國主 is a state's ruler

44.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 44-gou.json; L1's 制動之主 is L4 as the brake, not master of Gou

45.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 45-cui.json; Judgment note 以剛為主，主剛而履中 names a quality, like 30, not a line

46.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 46-sheng.json; L6 warns against 為物之主

50.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 50-ding.json; L1's 室主 is the mistress of the house

51.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 51-zhen.json; L4 為眾陰之主 is master of the yin lines, not named master of Zhen

52.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 52-gen.json; L3's 體分兩主 — no master

54.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 54-guimei.json; L3's 室主 is the mistress of the house

55.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 55-feng.json; Judgment note 為天下之主 is the king, no line named; L4's 夷主 is the peer lord, not a hexagram master

56.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 56-lv2.json; 物失其主 and L3's 主之所疑 — no master named

61.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 61-zhongfu.json; L5's 為群物之主 is ruler of all things, not named master of Zhongfu

62.checked: chinese-classics-reference: 62-xiaoguo.json; L4's 不為貴主 says it is not the master
